components.name: Primary button
components.description: Primary action from the agreed button specification.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 13px Geist, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #F5B544; color: #0E0F11; font-weight: 600; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5B544; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Secondary action from the agreed button specification.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font: 13px Geist, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #3A3F46; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #E7E8EA; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5B544; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Number box
components.description: Number field based on the agreed settings control.
components.html: <label class="ds-label">Daily cap <input class="ds-control ds-number" type="number" placeholder="No cap"></label>
components.css: .ds-label { font: 13px Geist, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; color: #E7E8EA; } .ds-number { font: 13px Geist, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; display: block; width: 170px; height: 34px; margin-top: 8px; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid #3A3F46; border-radius: 8px; background: #0E0F11; color: #E7E8EA; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5B544; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project navigation
components.description: Project navigation row based on the left bar specification.
components.css: .ds-row { font: 13px Geist, sans-serif; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #16181B; color: #E7E8EA; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F5B544; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Skill chip
components.description: Skill provenance label from the conversation specification.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid #23262B; border-radius: 999px; background: #16181B; color: #E7E8EA; font: 11px "Geist Mono", monospace; }

narrative.overview: The interface is warm and approachable. It gives the owner and role bots a clear place to work together, with familiar controls and visible bot identities. Keep the conversation easy to read through long work sessions.
keyCharacteristics: Compact controls and a clear reading area.
Distinct bot avatars and visible work states.
Semantic colours, with labels or icons for status.
dos: Do use the agreed component specifications and UI rules.
Do make bot authorship and work states clear.
Do use the word "conversation" in the interface.
donts: Don't rely on colour alone to communicate a state.
Don't treat an illustration as an approved component specification.
